I don’t know if it’s because he misses him or he is anticipating him coming home because he usually comes home at night (likely both).  He surprised me when he used one of his new buttons - Come - to say “Daddy Come Riggie”. While this is a new button for him, it certainly is not a new word, as that has been his recall word from day 1. 📍Riga, Latvia 🇱🇻 If you’re looking for a European Christmas market that’s a little less obvious, put Riga on your list. 🎄✨ The Christmas market is right in the heart of Riga’s Old Town, around Dome Square, with wooden stalls selling artisan crafts, gifts and plenty of festive treats. You can try traditional Latvian food like 🫛🥓 grey peas with bacon, 🥟 piragi and 🍪 gingerbread, along with steaming cups of mulled wine and Riga Black Balsam. 🎶 There are also live performances, traditional Latvian folk music, carol singing and dancing throughout the festive season.
